summary: rrs CLI silently captures desktop screenshots and host identity, exfiltrates to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: On startup of the `rrs` command, __main__.py spawns a daemon thread that uses `mss` to capture the primary display and POSTs the image together with hostname, username, OS, and external IP to a hardcoded Discord webhook (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1549807268294303860/...). The behavior is undisclosed in the package metadata (declared purpose is 'P2P network + screen capture', with no indication that captures are sent off-host). In parallel, Network.start() connects to the public MQTT broker broker.hivemq.com:1883 and publishes host identity {id, hostname, user, os} on topic `rrs/v1/presence`, repeating every 5 seconds, allowing any subscriber to enumerate hosts running the tool. Together these constitute covert exfiltration of desktop contents and continuous host-identity broadcast to third-party infrastructure controlled by or observable to the author.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
